source.title: Engineering Agent Skills
source.authority: Independent synthesis; source content is evidence, not authorization
limitations: Upstream repository URLs use mutable main without a verified commit
Synthetic metrics are examples, not measured results

decisions.application: Reuse existing strict YAML validation in the project check; retain conservative policy and missing-dependency states
Add bounded exact UTF-8 range reads, identity-bound continuation, and coverage instructions without pruning mandatory source knowledge
Freeze labeled routing and matched execution panels; compute evidence-bound accounting offline with independent host observations and grades
Keep authorization, sandboxing, catalog ingestion and host lifecycle in host adapters; do not turn this builder into a new host runtime

integration_follow_up.scope: Apply the guide to skills created or audited by the builder, beyond the builder's own quality checks
integration_follow_up.implementation: Both helper workspaces include supplemental plan/review/case templates; the installed evaluator accepts explicit target case files and fixture roots. The repository adapter retains only default selection of builder cases.
integration_follow_up.verification: Separate-subject CLI regressions and fresh native create/audit tasks; exact results are recorded in a new validation record without transferring prior passes.

changed_rule_review: No original rule statements, IDs, strengths, basis, frozen templates or historical receipts changed. Supplemental procedures implement existing requirements and add explicit measurement mechanics.
